title.narrative: NRC Supporting Solutions to Displacement in Fragile & Conflict-Affected Contexts
NRC Supporting Solutions to Displacement in Fragile & Conflict-Affected Contexts

description.narrative: Stöd till att stärka en hållbar återintegrering av flyktingar och migranter i Somalia och Afghanistan genom att förbättra tillgången till rättigheter, skydd, tillfredsställande levnadsvillkor och grundläggande tjänster samt genom att stärka samordning i de båda kontexterna.

Support to strengthening sustainable reintegration of displacement-affected populations in Somalia and Afghanistan by improving access to rights, protection, adequate living conditions and essential services, while strengthening the coordination in both contexts.

The intervention consists of two country programmes, in Somalia and Afghanistan, under a common framework for supporting durable solutions to displacement through the strengthening of sustainable reintegration of displacement displacement-affected populations. This will be done by improving access to rights, protection, adequate living conditions and essential services, while strengthening the community, institutional and coordination systems needed to sustain results beyond the intervention period.
Across both components, the intervention is intended to achieve change at three interconnected levels: improved conditions and opportunities for individuals and households; stronger community and service-delivery systems; and more effective coordination, evidence and institutional arrangements for durable solutions.
The Somalia component is expected to contribute to the following outcomes:
1) An enabling environment is created for sustainable (re)integration of displacement affected populations - by improving access to housing, land and tenure security, livelihoods, employment pathways, financial inclusion and social cohesion 2) Displacement affected populations have improved access to their rights, protection, and basic services - including access to legal identity, legal assistance, protection, education, healthcare and other basic services. 3) Government institutions have strengthened capacity to coordinate, monitor, plan and lead in providing inclusive and accountable solutions for displacement affected populations - through service mapping, referral systems, settlement planning, preparedness mechanisms and improved use of data.
The Somalia component will be implemented in the Benadir Regional Administration, Jubaland and Somaliland, including return, transit and settlement areas such as Mogadishu, Kismayo, Hargeisa and Burao.
The Afghanistan component is expected to contribute to the following objectives:
1) Displacement-affected Afghans have improved access to rights, legal documentation, protection and information to support informed and voluntary decisions on (re)integration 2) Displacement-affected Afghans experience improved wellbeing, living conditions and access to essential services through shelter, housing, land and property assistance, WASH, protection support and stronger referral pathways. 3) Policy, practices and sector reform efforts are shaped by evidence and learning generated through the project
The Afghanistan component will be implemented in Herat and Badghis.
